ObservableBarrier: Students memorize wave formulas from static blackboard sketches without ever seeing or hearing an actual acoustic waveform.
VerifiedSourceEvidence: UDISE+: Integrated science lab facility available in 51.7% of government secondary sections (~48.3% lack facility). NAS 2021: Class 8 science drops to 42% due to rote abstraction.
ExistingFlawedResponse: Static textbook diagrams (NCERT Class 8 Ch 13); lecture videos on DIKSHA showing teachers talking at chalkboards.
OpenResearchQuestion: How to enable tactile audible physics experimentation without expensive tuning forks or lab oscilloscopes?
FeasibleHackathonDemonstrationMeasure: Toggling 220 Hz vs 440 Hz on budget phone; audibly distinguishing octave pitch shift; observing 60 FPS oscilloscope sine wave double in compression on HTML5 canvas.

TargetLearner: Grade 6-7 rural students transitioning to proportional reasoning
ObservableBarrier: Students frequently fall into Additive Equipartition (4 4 4) or Raw Ratio (1 2 3) traps when dividing resources proportionally (misconception frequency is a working design hypothesis; broader division deficit verified).
VerifiedSourceEvidence: ASER 2023: 56.7% of surveyed rural youth aged 14-18 cannot solve basic division; >60% fail applied everyday arithmetic tasks.
ExistingFlawedResponse: Formulaic mechanical procedures (x+2x+3x=12) that students memorize without spatial or proportional intuition.
OpenResearchQuestion: How to provide instant visual feedback that prevents students from entering inconsistent totals or arbitrary sums?
FeasibleHackathonDemonstrationMeasure: Using steppers to allocate water in Water Share Challenge; flagging 4 4 4 as violating ratio 1:2:3; validating 2 4 6 with proportional bar animations.

FramingTitle: The Invisible Danger Water Testing Fallacy
TargetLearner: Grade 7 students testing household liquids and water quality
ObservableBarrier: Students conflate chemical neutrality with biological potability (believing pH 7 water is sterile and guaranteed safe to drink).
VerifiedSourceEvidence: NCERT Class 7 Science Ch 5 (Acids Bases Salts); field water quality reports (Note: quantitative Ministry of Jal Shakti audit claims unverified without direct primary source document).
ExistingFlawedResponse: Rote memorization of litmus paper color charts; zero practical testing reagents in rural classrooms.
OpenResearchQuestion: How to teach chemical indicators while reinforcing the critical life-safety boundary that pH testing does not detect pathogens?
FeasibleHackathonDemonstrationMeasure: Testing lemon juice (pH 2.2) distilled water (pH 7.0) baking soda (pH 8.5) and soap (pH 10.0) with turmeric/universal indicator while displaying an unmissable permanent disclaimer: pH 7.0 does NOT prove water is safe to drink.

TargetLearner: Grade 7-8 students learning ecology and conservation
ObservableBarrier: Students view ecosystems as isolated linear chains (A->B); blind to indirect trophic cascades (predator loss indirectly crashing herbivores).
VerifiedSourceEvidence: NCERT Class 7 & 8 Science; Driver et al. (1994) empirical research on linear causality misconceptions in biology.
ExistingFlawedResponse: Static 2D food chain drawings in textbooks with arrows frequently misunderstood as what an animal hunts rather than energy flow.
OpenResearchQuestion: How to simulate trophic cascades without overwhelming budget smartphone processors with heavy agent physics?
FeasibleHackathonDemonstrationMeasure: Toggling Remove Snakes on clean SVG farm food web; frog node updates to Surging; grasshopper node updates to Declining with qualitative trophic explanations.

TargetLearner: Rural siblings sharing working parents single phone between 7-8:30 PM (working design hypothesis based on field reports)
ObservableBarrier: Cellular 2G/3G data is intermittent and expensive; video streaming buffers; adult email logins lock children out and siblings overwrite progress.
VerifiedSourceEvidence: ASER 2023: 89% household phone access; 66.1% of users report ed-use. UDISE+: 58.6% schools have net nationally (rural connectivity outages frequent). IDinsight (2021) shared device field studies.
ExistingFlawedResponse: Cloud LMS portals requiring individual Google accounts and high-bandwidth broadband (Khan Academy BYJUS).
OpenResearchQuestion: How to allow children to track progress with zero logins and zero data consumption?
FeasibleHackathonDemonstrationMeasure: One-time Wi-Fi load; Cache-First Service Worker operates offline on cached device; single anonymous progress saved in localStorage (profile switcher UI deferred from MVP).
